guidance.statement: Eyeing 20 additional stores over the next 18-24 months

operating_notes.text: Partnered with Reliance Fashion Factory to expand retail presence in 25+ stores for inventory liquidation and working capital efficiency.
Signed two franchise stores in Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi, targeting openings in May 2026.
Opened fifth retail store in October 2026 in Model Town, Ludhiana, under Project 50.

timeline.summary: On April 23, 2026, Nandani Creation announced a partnership with Reliance Fashion Factory to expand its retail presence across 25+ stores for inventory liquidation and working capital optimization.
On May 6, 2026, Nandani Creation announced the signing of two franchise stores in Karol Bagh and Rohini, Delhi, under the Jaipur Kurti brand.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹30.27 Cr (+53.0% YoY), net profit ₹0.75 Cr.
Nandani Creation opens 5th retail store in October 2026 under Project 50 expansion
